limits_note: No root. Bandwidth ratio 5:1. At 10 TB stored you get 50 TB/mo, enough for 30 TB serving but with a hard edge. Coupon BFBOX (40% recurring) is widely cited on LET and moves the effective price materially; the list price is what is recorded below.
reliability_note: Multiple positive LET reviews over 12+ months ('uptime + speed has me impressed', 'genuinely, I couldn't be a happier customer'). One documented US storage-box migration with TB-scale accounts moved by batched rsync. Crypto payments are explicitly non-refundable (7-day money-back applies to card/PayPal only).
